facts.fact: On 6 January 2026 UCC said Starlink had not met its requirements and that Starlink terminals were being imported and used illegally, per TechMoonshot.
By May 2026 Starlink held a provisional infrastructure and service licence in Uganda, with a condition of a national gateway in Uganda, per TechMoonshot.

note: Airtel satellite-to-phone service launched 24 Sep 2026 is direct-to-cell, not a fact.
